description: This file defines a utility function `createRestartIterationHook` that creates an iteration hook used in restart loops. The hook executes a callback `onRestart` on subsequent calls, skipping the initial call.

methods.name: export function createRestartIterationHook(onRestart: () => void): () => boolean { createRestartIterationHook
methods.description: Creates and returns an iteration hook function that manages restart logic for in-process restart loops. The initial call does nothing; subsequent calls invoke `onRestart`.
